text: The documented entrypoints are no-install `uvx --from git+https://github.com/selkios/outcomegraph og ...`, installed `og` via `uv tool install --from git+https://github.com/selkios/outcomegraph outcomegraph`, and `uv run og <command>` from a source checkout; daemon mode is documented through `daemon install|start|status`, with `og daemon install` described as pinning the launcher to the current interpreter/module context.
